action.name: Multiattack
entries: Narthus makes two attacks using Vile Mace or Fateful Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Vile Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Fateful Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 120 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) Necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of Narthus's next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.
